settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person winter warfare realism at Bastogne, December 1944. U.S. airborne POV, snow, fog, pine woods, frozen foxholes, damaged town streets, cold breath and exhausted human movement. Excitement comes from silence, distant engines, limited visibility, sudden reveals and short danger beats rather than nonstop combat.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. POV faction remains U.S. airborne / U.S. defending forces throughout. Nearby friendlies are U.S.; German attackers remain clearly separated across tree lines, roads, fog or attack direction. Weapon state varies naturally and is frequently lowered, slung, resting, partial-frame or absent during digging, snow clearing, supply handling, observation and recovery. Use cinematic reveal and tension without copying any specific film shot.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person winter reenactment with muted snow color, fog depth, cold breath, human-weight camera motion, still waiting, tactile gloves and snow, and strong sound contrast between silence and distant battlefield activity.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP04 — Bastogne: Surrounded in the Snow
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. airborne soldier reaches Bastogne, endures frozen defensive positions, shortages and fog, then experiences resupply and the opening of a relief corridor while the wider battle continues.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Make the viewer feel physically present in a frozen Bastogne perimeter. Use fog, snow texture, breath, frozen ground, pine branches, slush, equipment handling and distant engines as story elements. Do not keep the rifle centered in every shot. The soldier may dig with both hands, clear snow, carry supplies, study the tree line, rest the rifle against a foxhole, walk through town or simply wait. Nearby friendlies remain U.S. forces; German attackers are visible only as a clearly separated opposing threat. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Road to Bastogne
scenes.description: The soldier rides toward Bastogne through winter roads.
scenes.actionDescription: One hand grips the truck side while the rifle hangs slung and bumps against the body.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person U.S. airborne view from open truck, gloved hand on cold metal, slushy road, U.S. convoy ahead, rifle mostly off-center by sling, gray winter sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Truck-sway POV with brief look from hand on rail to convoy ahead. Audio: engine, slush, wind, gear, breath, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Town Passage
scenes.description: A moving environmental exploration through Bastogne streets.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks beside the vehicle column with rifle slung, looking between stone buildings, carts and U.S. traffic.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person walk through winter Bastogne, U.S. jeeps and soldiers nearby, stone facades, broken windows, snow and slush, no German troops mixed in the friendly street.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow street-level walk and one side glance into a damaged doorway. Audio: boots in slush, engines, wind, distant guns, breath.

scenes.title: Frozen Ground
scenes.description: The soldier begins digging a foxhole with both hands.
scenes.actionDescription: The rifle rests against a pine while both hands strike frozen soil with an entrenching tool.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low view of gloved hands digging hard earth, snow crust and roots; M1 rifle visibly resting off to the side against a tree.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low repetitive digging motion. Audio: metal on frozen ground, glove friction, wind in pines, strained breathing, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Fog on the Line
scenes.description: A long observation scene with almost no action.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sits low in the foxhole, rifle resting on the edge but not aimed, and watches fog swallow the field.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person seated foxhole view, snow rim, foggy field and tree line, rifle lying horizontally at the edge rather than centered, visible cold breath.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still camera with tiny head sway. Audio: wind, snow grains, cloth, breath, distant engine barely audible. No music.

scenes.title: Engine in the Mist
scenes.description: Tension grows as a distant German armored silhouette appears through fog.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier raises binoculars instead of the rifle and studies a distant German vehicle shape beyond the opposing tree line.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view through fog, distant German armored silhouette spatially separated across the field, U.S. foxhole foreground unseen except slight glove edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and long hold. Audio: faint engine rumble, wind, faster breath; no shot fired.

scenes.title: Snow Falls From the Trees
scenes.description: A near impact shakes snow from nearby branches.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier ducks deeper as a distant impact sends snow and needles raining into the foxhole.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low foxhole view, snow and pine needles falling close to camera, U.S. sleeve visible, rifle partly buried under a light dusting at the edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick duck, then hold while snow falls. Audio: distant thump, branches shake, muffled hearing for a beat, breath and snow hiss.

scenes.title: Supply Check
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier kneels and opens a small ammunition and ration container while the rifle remains laid aside.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands opening a box with limited ammunition and ration items, frosted gloves, snow around foxhole, rifle resting off-frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close view of box and hands. Audio: latch, cartridges, wind, breath, distant battle almost absent. No music.

scenes.title: Walk the Pine Line
scenes.description: The soldier slowly explores a short stretch of the defensive woods during a lull.
scenes.actionDescription: With rifle slung, he walks between U.S. foxholes, brushing snow from a low pine branch with one empty hand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand pushing snow from pine needles, U.S. positions spaced along the woods, boot prints, fog beyond, no German troops nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow walking exploration at human pace with side glances into foxholes. Audio: boots on snow, branches, fabric, breath.

scenes.title: Night Watch
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sits with the rifle resting against the wall and rubs gloved hands together under moonlight.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person seated-height foxhole, faint moonlit snow, hands close together, rifle resting to side, dark field beyond, visible breath.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still. No gunfire nearby and no music. Audio: cold wind, glove rubbing, breath, one distant artillery roll.

scenes.title: Bastogne Morning
scenes.description: A resupply walk through damaged town streets.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier carries a supply box with both hands through a U.S.-held street, rifle slung behind him.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person supply box dominating foreground, U.S. jeeps and soldiers, slush and stone buildings, rifle not visible, no enemy mixed into the position.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady two-handed carry through one block. Audio: box rattle, boots, engines, wind, breath.

scenes.title: The Sky Opens
scenes.description: A cinematic reveal as cloud cover finally breaks.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stops clearing snow from the foxhole and slowly looks upward as sunlight breaks through.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloved hand on snow rim, blue opening forming in winter clouds above pine woods, weapon out of frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Start close on hand and snow, then slow upward reveal to clearing sky. Audio: wind softens, aircraft faintly emerge, breath.

scenes.title: Parachutes
scenes.description: Supply parachutes descend beyond the tree line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier stands with empty hands and follows one parachute drifting down.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person upward/forward view of supply parachutes under clear winter sky, U.S. soldiers watching from friendly ground, no weapon visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan following one parachute from sky toward distant field. Audio: aircraft, wind, parachute fabric, breath.

scenes.title: Pass It Down
scenes.description: A practical resupply handoff along the foxhole line.
scenes.actionDescription: Both hands pass an ammunition box to another U.S. soldier while the rifle rests behind the POV.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person gloves handing box across snowy defensive line, U.S. sleeves and gear only, weapon absent from foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: One clean handoff motion. Audio: box scrape, cartridges, snow, wind, breathing.

scenes.title: Engines From the South
scenes.description: Friendly relief traffic becomes visible through the winter haze.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier steps to the roadside with rifle lowered and watches U.S. vehicles approach from the friendly direction.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person snowy road, distant U.S. vehicles entering the Bastogne area, rifle low at the side, U.S. troops nearby, German forces absent from the friendly road.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan toward approaching vehicles, then hold. Audio: engines growing, snow under boots, wind, breath.

scenes.title: Back to the Line
scenes.description: The soldier returns quietly to the snowy perimeter.
scenes.actionDescription: With the rifle slung, he walks back among pine trees and foxholes at a tired pace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person fatigued walk into U.S. defensive woods, boot prints, late-day blue snow, rifle sling edge only, town fading behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady tired walk with natural sway. Audio: boots on snow, gear, distant guns, breathing. End without victory celebration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier
characters.description: Anonymous U.S. airborne first-person soldier defending Bastogne with historically plausible winter equipment.
characters.mainOutfit: M43 field layers, airborne web gear, M1 helmet, winter gloves, M1 rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain U.S. forces. German attackers remain clearly separated across opposing terrain. Keep snow, mud, frost, fatigue and equipment continuity. Weapon state varies naturally by scene.

atmosphereAssets.title: Road to Bastogne
atmosphereAssets.description: U.S.-held snowy roads, convoy traffic, slush and winter fields; enemy forces never mixed into friendly columns.

atmosphereAssets.title: Bastogne Town
atmosphereAssets.description: U.S.-held stone streets, military traffic, cold haze and damage without graphic imagery.

atmosphereAssets.title: Bastogne Perimeter Woods
atmosphereAssets.description: U.S. foxholes in snowy pine woods facing clearly separated German threat beyond foggy fields and tree lines.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: foggy day, winter night, clearing sky
